MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Master Services Agreement (the “Agreement”) is between Acme Analytics
Private Limited (the “Customer”) and Bharat Cloud Services Private Limited
(the “Supplier”), effective 1 January 2027.

1. Services. The Supplier shall provide hosted analytics services and deliver
monthly service reports within 5 business days after each calendar month.

2. Fees and Payment. The Customer shall pay INR 10,00,000 annually against a
valid invoice, within 30 days of receipt. Taxes are additional.

3. Term and Renewal. The initial term is one year. The Agreement automatically
renews for successive one-year periods unless either party gives 30 days’ prior
written notice of non-renewal.

4. Termination. Either party may terminate for convenience on 30 days’ written
notice. Either party may terminate for cause for a material breach not cured
within 15 days after written notice. Termination does not affect accrued payment
obligations.

5. Indemnification. The Supplier shall indemnify and hold harmless the Customer
from third-party claims arising from the Supplier’s services, subject to the
limitations stated below.

6. Limitation of Liability. Each party’s aggregate liability is capped at the
fees paid in the previous 12 months. The cap does not apply to fraud,
confidentiality breaches, or indemnification obligations. Neither party is
liable for consequential damages.

7. Confidentiality. Confidential information must be protected and may be
disclosed only to personnel with a need to know, subject to customary
exceptions. These obligations survive termination for 7 years.

8. Intellectual Property. Customer owns all work product created specifically
for Customer, and Supplier assigns that work product to Customer. Supplier
retains its background IP and grants Customer a license to use it.

9. Governing Law and Jurisdiction. This Agreement is governed by the laws of
India. The courts at Bengaluru, Karnataka have exclusive jurisdiction.

10. Non-Solicit. During the term and for 12 months after termination, neither
party shall solicit the other party’s employees in India.
